name: Tsun M! 2 ~Uchi no Kanojo wa Kawaii Pet~
original_name: ツンえむ！2 ～うちのカノジョは可愛いペット～
source:
Nemu, his cousin and lover who has run away from home (?).
Since the relationship was approved by both parents, it was natural that she was placed in care.
He made it clear that their relationship would remain platonic until graduation.

However, Nemu finds some SM-related pornographic magazines that a colleague had been keeping for her.

"You won't do it with me... because this is your hobby...?
Because with me, it seems like you can only have normal sex...!?

Nemu began rummaging through her bag and, of all things, handed me a collar.

"Put a collar around my neck... I don't want to wear one, but...
Please put a collar on me like the woman in this book...!!"

So I had no choice but to accept the collar.
I won't give up until you do what I say.

Thus begins the protagonist and Nemu's days with the collar on.

[Translated From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1080822&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
离家出走的表弟兼恋人涅姆（？）。
既然这段关系得到了双方父母的认可，自然就将她安置在照顾之中了。
他明确表示，他们的关系将保持柏拉图式的关系，直到毕业。

然而，Nemu发现了同事一直为她保管的一些与SM相关的色情杂志。

“你不会和我一起做……因为这是你的爱好……？
因为在我看来，你只能进行正常的性行为……！？

涅姆开始翻遍她的包，最重要的是递给我一个项圈。

“给我脖子戴一个项圈……我不想戴，但是……
请像这本书里的女人一样给我戴上项圈……！！”

于是我只好接受了项圈。
除非你按照我说的去做，否则我不会放弃。

主角和涅梦带着项圈的日子就这样开始了。”

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1080822&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
